description.en: Occasionally summons other kongfu zombies, or pulls all the plants ahead with qigong.
description.zh: 偶尔召唤其他功夫僵尸，或用气功拉动身前的植物。

chat.en: Bronze of Qigong acts like he's one of the eight Vajrapanis, due to his endeavor spending his whole life meditating.
chat.zh: 气功铜人的表现已经达到八大金刚的级别，归功于他耗尽一生的冥想。

text.en: crushes plants with his Buddhist staff
uses qigong to pull all the plants ahead
text.zh: 能发动气功，吸收身前的所有植物
